name: external_v1
registration_context: Third fixed candidate planned after initial spatial outer-fold results were already visible and after Melvyn requested a stronger research direction; registered before any external-pretraining or external-CV result. This does not reset prior development-set exposure.
hypothesis: Clean external source diversity and adaptation of late watermark-decoder features can improve evidence for watermark presence before fitting competition masks. Large gains are a hypothesis, not a guaranteed outcome.
architecture: SpatialSegmenter with unchanged module names and state-dict structure; only during external pretraining, PixelSeal stages 2 and 3 and their downsample layers receive gradients. Adobe ResNet body remains frozen; Adobe FPN and dense segmentation layers train.
external_augmentation: None; exact encoded RGB and masks, constant 0.5 in all six guide channels so guide features are zero after centering.
external_loss: Existing BCE plus equally weighted foreground/background soft Dice.
external_encoder_mode: All pretrained PixelSeal stages stay in eval mode to preserve deterministic released feature behavior; stages 2 and 3 nevertheless receive gradients. Frozen Adobe body stays in eval mode.
external_selection: Fixed final epoch 10. No early stopping, threshold selection, or checkpoint selection on external validation. Report external validation once after training at threshold 0.5.
external_memory_test: The first real batch contains 16 samples; verify late PixelSeal gradients and record peak CUDA memory after its optimizer update. OOM stops the run without reducing the registered batch size.
external_initialization_reuse: One external-only final checkpoint is shared by all five real-data folds. Ordinary SpatialSegmenter loads it strictly and freezes every PixelSeal parameter during real fitting.
real_training: Same nested splits and aligned eight-view decoder guidance as synthetic_v1, with 324 real fit parents and 84 inner tune images per fold. Start every fold independently from the identical external-only checkpoint; use a fresh ordinary SpatialSegmenter optimizer and 120-epoch schedule.
selection: Real inner tune only: method-specific checkpoints at epoch 1 and multiples of 5; threshold grid 0.2 through 0.8 in increments of 0.05.
reference: Strongest prior candidate promoted by the frozen gate; never select the reference using public leaderboard scores.
promotion: All five paired fold gains positive; mean OOF gain at least 0.002; conditional paired bootstrap 99% lower bound positive using 20000 resamples and seed 20261126.
public_leaderboard: Receipt tracking only; no architecture, checkpoint, threshold or promotion tuning.
limitations: Generated crop-and-hole edits approximate competition edits and need not match generative image modifications. Filtering external sources reduces known overlap but cannot prove independence when original competition source identifiers are absent. The reused 510-image development set and multiple registered candidates create model-selection uncertainty; only organizer-held evaluation supplies an additional check. Adapting an extractor does not recreate the joint embedder/extractor training or reported performance of published watermark systems.
